name.full: GitHub Toolkit for M365 Copilot Cowork

description.short: Read and act on GitHub repos, issues, PRs, and Actions inside Cowork.
description.full: Connects Copilot Cowork to GitHub's official remote MCP server (https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/). Lets Cowork search code, read repositories and files, triage issues, review pull requests, inspect GitHub Actions runs, and summarize development activity — all scoped to what the signed-in user is allowed to see via OAuth.

agentConnectors.description: GitHub's official remote MCP server. Exposes repositories, files, code search, issues, pull requests, Actions workflow runs, notifications, and security alerts over Streamable HTTP with OAuth.
